t: Genghis Khan united the steppe tribes in 1206 and built the largest contiguous land empire in history.
Under the Pax Mongolica, protected trade routes linked China, the Middle East and Europe as never before.
Succession wars split it into rival khanates after 1260; the Yuan fell to the Ming in 1368.
dyk: The Mongols generally tolerated diverse faiths, even granting clergy tax exemptions in return for prayers for the khan.
ev: Temüjin is proclaimed Genghis Khan at a kurultai on the Mongolian steppe
Genghis Khan destroys the Khwarazmian Empire in Central Asia
Subutai and Jebe defeat the Rus and Kipchaks at the Kalka River
Mongol armies defeat Polish and Hungarian forces at Legnica and Mohi
Hülegü sacks Baghdad, ending the Abbasid Caliphate
The succession war between Kublai and Ariq Böke splits the empire into khanates
Kublai's death removes the last Great Khan widely recognised across the empire
The Ming drive the Yuan dynasty out of China
